# Deployed Contracts

## Deployed Contracts

This page lists Hanji contract addresses across supported chains. For aggregator integrations, the active market list is the `/aggregators/markets` API response.

### Aggregator Source of Truth

For external aggregators, use `/aggregators/markets` as the source of truth for active markets.

The `orderbookAddress` returned by this endpoint is the **proxy orderbook address** to use for both quoting and execution. Do not integrate against underlying CLOB addresses directly unless you intentionally want to ignore FastQuoter virtual liquidity.

To quote depth for aggregator routing, call `FastQuoterHelper.assembleOrderbookFromOrders(orderbookAddress, isAsk, maxPriceLevels)` using the same proxy orderbook address returned by the API. To execute, call the CLOB-compatible methods on that same proxy orderbook address.

If the static tables below and the API response ever differ, prefer the API response.

See [Liquidity Source Integration](https://docs.hanji.io/for-developers/liquidity-source-integration) for the full integration flow.
